caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular rug with a tan or light brown background. The central feature is a circular floral wreath, consisting of leaves, flowers, and berries in various colors, including shades of green, red, pink, purple, yellow, and white. The leaves are mainly green, with some showing shades of yellow, and the flowers are scattered in hues of red, pink, purple, and yellow. A border runs close to the edge of the rug, featuring similar foliage motifs; grapevine leaves and clusters of purple or light blue grapes are arranged symmetrically along the border. The perimeter of the rug is outlined with a thin, darker line. The overall composition is balanced with botanical motifs repeated in the central wreath and the border, all set against the uniform tan background.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
